description:
Live Google Maps traffic incidents (accidents, construction, road closures, slowdowns) with type and coordinates inside a map area.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- traffic_alerts (required: bottom_left, top_right): Traffic Alerts

When to use: For Waze driver-reported alerts, jams and police reports use waze.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: google_maps_traffic_alerts
